verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor (CPU and NPU silicon), and an official MCP server for agent connectivity is not a capability a buyer comparing processors would reasonably expect from the chip itself. Nothing in the evidence shows an MCP server: the docs cover CPU, NPU and memory specs plus AI Hub model tooling, and the probes find only an llms.txt file with no API surface. The axis is therefore a category error for this product type.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
